fsm_states_sdram.name: Power Applied
fsm_states_sdram.description: Initial state at power-on; RESET# LOW, CKE LOW, all banks in undefined state.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Reset Procedure
fsm_states_sdram.description: RESET# is asserted LOW (200 µs at power-up, 100 ns thereafter) with CKE LOW; DRAM internal logic is reset; ODT in high-impedance.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Initialization
fsm_states_sdram.description: After RESET# deassertion + 500 µs + CKE rising HIGH with stable CK + tXPR: DRAM is in initialization phase, awaiting MRS sequence and ZQCL.

fsm_states_sdram.name: ZQ Calibration
fsm_states_sdram.description: ZQCL triggers full calibration engine; tZQinit (≥ 512 nCK) is required for the first calibration after reset.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Idle
fsm_states_sdram.description: All banks precharged, all timing parameters met, CKE HIGH, MR0..MR3 programmed. Ready to accept ACT / REF / SRE / MRS / ZQCL / ZQCS / PDE / RESET.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Refreshing
fsm_states_sdram.description: Auto Refresh in progress; entered by REF command from Idle; tRFC must elapse before returning to Idle.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Self Refresh
fsm_states_sdram.description: Entered by SRE (CKE LOW with REF code) from Idle; DRAM generates its own refresh; external CK may be stopped after tCKSRE; exit via CKE rising with stable CK for tCKSRX, then tXS / tXSDLL.

fsm_states_sdram.name: MRS / MPR / Write Leveling
fsm_states_sdram.description: Entered from Idle by MRS command; tMRD between MRS commands; tMOD before a non-MRS command. MPR and Write Leveling are mode-register-controlled sub-states reached from Idle.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Activating
fsm_states_sdram.description: ACT command latched; row is opening in addressed bank; tRCD must elapse before the first column command to that bank.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Bank Active
fsm_states_sdram.description: One or more banks have an open row; bank ready for READ / WRITE / PRE / further ACT to a different bank (subject to tRRD / tFAW).

fsm_states_sdram.name: Reading
fsm_states_sdram.description: Read burst in flight; DQ being driven by DRAM at RL = AL + CL from RD command.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Writing
fsm_states_sdram.description: Write burst in flight; DQ being sunk by DRAM at WL = AL + CWL from WR command.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Reading + AutoPrecharge
fsm_states_sdram.description: RDA: read burst followed by automatic PRECHARGE of the bank after the burst completes.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Writing + AutoPrecharge
fsm_states_sdram.description: WRA: write burst followed by automatic PRECHARGE after tWR from the last write data beat.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Precharging
fsm_states_sdram.description: PRE / PREA in progress; bank(s) closing; tRP must elapse before another ACT or before MRS / REF / SRE.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Active Power-Down
fsm_states_sdram.description: CKE LOW with at least one bank open; tXP to exit (NOP/DES + CKE HIGH).

fsm_states_sdram.name: Precharge Power-Down
fsm_states_sdram.description: CKE LOW with all banks precharged; Fast Exit (MR0 A12=1, DLL on) → tXP; Slow Exit (A12=0, DLL frozen) → tXPDLL.

fsm_transitions_major.description: Initial entry; tINIT ≥ 200 µs after power stable.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: RESET# rising + 500 µs + CKE rising + tXPR
fsm_transitions_major.description: Standard init sequence; MR2 → MR3 → MR1 → MR0 → ZQCL → tDLLK + tZQinit → Idle.
Read burst on DQ at RL = AL + CL; back to Bank Active.
Write burst at WL = AL + CWL; back to Bank Active after tWTR/tCCD.

fsm_transitions_major.target: Reading + AutoPrecharge → Precharging → Idle (if last bank)
Writing + AutoPrecharge → Precharging → Idle (if last bank)
fsm_transitions_major.description: Auto-precharge after tWR from last data beat.
tRP before next ACT to same bank.
CKE LOW with REF command code; DRAM holds itself in SR.
SRX; DLL must re-lock (tDLLK) before commands requiring DLL.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: MRS (Idle, all banks precharged, tRP met)
fsm_transitions_major.description: tMRD between MRS; tMOD before non-MRS.
Exit via PDX + tXP (fast) or tXPDLL (slow).
Asynchronous reset; tRESET ≥ 100 ns at stable power.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_POWER_UP
fsm_states_controller.description: Drive RESET# LOW, CKE LOW; ramp VDD/VDDQ; wait ≥ 200 µs after power stable.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_RESET_REL
fsm_states_controller.description: Deassert RESET#; wait 500 µs; bring CK stable; raise CKE HIGH with NOP/DES on command bus; wait tXPR.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_MR_PROGRAM
fsm_states_controller.description: MRS to MR2 (SR temperature, CWL, Rtt_WR) → MR3 (MPR disabled) → MR1 (DLL, Rtt_Nom, AL) → MR0 (BL, CL, WR, DLL Reset=1) → ZQCL → wait tDLLK and tZQinit.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_IDLE
fsm_states_controller.description: Periodically issue REF to maintain refresh; track tREFI and tFAW; schedule ZQCS periodically.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_ACTIVATE
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue ACT to open a row in target bank; respect tRCD before first column command; respect tRRD / tFAW for multi-bank activates.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_READ
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue RD / RDA at RL = AL + CL; receive DQ + DQS edge-aligned from DRAM; honour tCCD between column commands.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_WRITE
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue WR / WRA at WL = AL + CWL; drive DQ + DQS centred; honour tWR before precharge; honour tWTR before read.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_PRECHARGE
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue PRE (single) or PREA (all) to close row; wait tRP before next ACT to that bank.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_REFRESH
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue REF when all banks idle; wait tRFC; resume.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_SELF_REFRESH
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue SRE when system is idle; optionally stop CK after tCKSRE; on wake-up, restart CK, raise CKE, wait tCKSRX + tXS, issue ZQCL, wait tDLLK + tZQoper.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_controller.description: Lower CKE in Bank Active (APD) or Idle (PPD); resume via CKE HIGH + tXP / tXPDLL.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_WL_TRAIN
fsm_states_controller.description: Enter Write Leveling (MR1 A7=1); sweep DQS delay until 0→1 transition observed on DQ feedback; exit (MR1 A7=0).

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_RD_TRAIN
fsm_states_controller.description: Enter MPR (MR3 A2=1); issue RD/RDA; receive predefined pattern; sweep DQ sampling phase to find optimal window; exit (MR3 A2=0).

fsm_hints.trigger: All commands are committed on the rising edge of CK by simultaneous decode of CKE / CS# / RAS# / CAS# / WE#. The controller is the sole bus master; the DRAM never initiates a transaction.
fsm_hints.rule: DDR3 operates with deterministic latency; once a command is committed, the data movement on DQ is fixed by RL / WL / burst length without any handshake.
fsm_hints.abort: Bursts cannot be aborted or interrupted (CKE LOW in mid-burst aborts the DRAM internal state only; data on DQ continues by spec). RESET# is the only true abort; it asynchronously returns the DRAM to its reset state.

anti_deadlock_rule: Controller shall honour all timing parameters (tRCD, tRP, tRAS, tRC, tRRD, tFAW, tWR, tWTR, tRTP, tCCD, tRFC, tREFI, tMRD, tMOD, tCKE, tCKESR, tXP, tXPDLL, tXS, tXSDLL, tZQinit, tZQoper, tZQCS, tDLLK, tCKSRE, tCKSRX, tPRPDEN, tACTPDEN, tWRPDEN, tRDPDEN, tREFPDEN, tMRSPDEN, tIS, tIH) between successive commands. Violating these parameters causes undefined DRAM behaviour with no error indication.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on or RESET#, DRAM enters reset state. The 12-step initialization sequence (RESET# deassert, 500 µs wait, CK stable, CKE rising, tXPR wait, MR2/MR3/MR1/MR0 MRS, ZQCL, tDLLK + tZQinit wait) must complete before any user data command. RESET# must be HIGH throughout normal operation.

default_ready_state_recommendation.CK_idle: Differential CK / CK# must be running and stable in all states except possibly during Self-Refresh (after tCKSRE) and during the early part of Reset.
default_ready_state_recommendation.CKE_idle: HIGH during normal operation; LOW only for Power-Down or Self-Refresh.
default_ready_state_recommendation.ODT_idle: LOW unless RTT_Nom or RTT_WR is enabled in MR1/MR2 and a synchronous/dynamic/asynchronous ODT mode is in use.
default_ready_state_recommendation.RESET#_idle: HIGH (1.5 V) during normal operation; LOW only during reset assertion.
default_ready_state_recommendation.DQ_idle: High-impedance when DRAM is not driving (read direction quiescent); driven HIGH/LOW per data when controller is writing.
default_ready_state_recommendation.DQS_idle: High-impedance between bursts; differential to enable common-mode rejection.

configurations.name: Per-DRAM organization x4
configurations.description: DQ[3:0] per DRAM; common on RDIMM/LRDIMM rank-multiplied modules.

configurations.name: Per-DRAM organization x8
configurations.description: DQ[7:0] per DRAM; common on UDIMM/SO-DIMM.

configurations.name: Per-DRAM organization x16
configurations.description: DQ[15:0] per DRAM split into upper and lower bytes with DQSU/DQSL strobes; common on standalone components.

configurations.name: Single-die device
configurations.description: Standard JEDEC ballout; single CKE / CS# / ODT / ZQ.

configurations.name: Stacked / dual-die device
configurations.description: Two dies in one package; CKE0/CKE1, CS0#/CS1#, ODT0/ODT1, ZQ0/ZQ1 per die.

configurations.name: Quad-stacked / quad-die device
configurations.description: Four dies; CS0#..CS3#, ZQ0..ZQ3 per die.

configurations.name: DLL-off (test / low-speed)
configurations.description: MR1 A0=1; CL=6 and CWL=6 only; tDQSCK vendor-defined and may exceed tCK.

timing_dependency_rule: All address / command / control / CKE inputs (referenced to VREFCA) are set up before and held after the rising edge of CK by tIS / tIH. DQ inputs (referenced to VREFDQ) are set up before and held after both edges of DQS by tDS / tDH (with slew-rate-dependent derating per Sections 13.3 / 13.4). DQ outputs are launched edge-aligned with DQS on reads (after RL clock cycles). DQS outputs are centred in DQ on writes (after WL clock cycles).
